home.title: Know if solar pays off for your fleet <highlight>before you spend a euro.</highlight>
home.lead: Answer four questions about your vans, trucks, trailers or buses. Get the payback time, yearly savings and avoided CO₂, then track every vehicle group in one workspace.

dashboard.screenLabel: Sample fleet dashboard with yearly savings, average payback, avoided CO₂ and a list of vehicle groups

whyItPays.title: A business case for vehicle solar, not a sales pitch.
whyItPays.lead: Fleet managers need a number they can defend in a budget meeting. Solar Calculator gives you that number and shows where it comes from.
whyItPays.costsBody: See how much fuel and electricity the panels replace each year, for driving, idling and cooling units.
whyItPays.paybackBody: Pessimistic, realistic and optimistic scenarios, so you know the range before you commit a budget.
whyItPays.co2Body: Avoided emissions per vehicle group and for the whole fleet, ready for your sustainability report.
whyItPays.trustBody: Every input and assumption is listed with its source. Estimates, never quotes, and nothing to buy here.

result.title: One screen answers the question: does it pay off?
result.lead: A plain-language verdict first, then the money, the CO₂ and the year the panels have paid for themselves.
result.screenLabel: Sample result for ten delivery vans in Berlin with the payback time, yearly savings, one-time cost, avoided CO₂ and a chart of savings adding up over ten years
result.share: Share the result with one link

calculator.title: Four questions. No spreadsheet, no sales call.
calculator.body: Pick the vehicle type, how many you run, what they carry and where they operate. Not sure about a value? We fill in a typical one and tell you that we did.
calculator.point2: Refrigerated transport with diesel, engine-driven or electric cooling
calculator.point3: Sunlight data for your city, winter included
calculator.previewLabel: First calculator step asking what kind of vehicles you have

workspace.title: Your whole fleet, added up.
workspace.body: Save each estimate as a vehicle group. The dashboard totals the savings, averages the payback and shows which groups still need a calculation.
workspace.point1: Edit a group and recalculate in one step
workspace.point2: Outdated results are marked, never silently reused
workspace.point3: Full calculation history for every vehicle
workspace.previewLabel: Sample fleet total with three vehicle groups and their payback times

team.title: Bring in finance. Keep control.
team.body: Invite colleagues as owner, manager or viewer. Every change to a vehicle or a calculation is written to the activity log in plain sentences.
team.signIn: Sign in with an email link or Google. No passwords to manage.
team.previewLabel: Sample activity log with three recent changes by team members

mobile.title: Works in the depot, not only at the desk.
mobile.lead: Every page is built for a phone first. Run an estimate next to the vehicle, check the dashboard on the way to a meeting. Light and dark theme included.
mobile.calculatorLabel: Calculator on a phone, asking how far one vehicle drives on a normal day
mobile.dashboardLabel: Fleet dashboard on a phone with yearly savings and vehicle groups
mobile.resultLabel: Result on a phone with the payback time, yearly savings and avoided CO₂

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: Pick the vehicle type, how many you run and what they carry.
howItWorks.step2Body: Choose the city and how far the vehicles drive on a normal day.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: This page explains in plain words which personal data Solar Calculator stores and why.

calculator.title: Using the calculator without an account
calculator.body: The quick check runs in your browser. Your answers are kept in the page address and in your browser's session storage. Nothing is saved on our servers until you sign in and save a result.

account.title: Your account
account.body: When you sign in we store your email address and, if you use Google, your name and profile picture. We use them only to sign you in and to show your team who you are.

fleet.title: Fleet data
fleet.body: Vehicles, locations and calculations you save belong to your fleet. Only members of that fleet can see them. Actions in a fleet are recorded in an activity log without names or email addresses.

email.title: Sign-in emails
email.body: Sign-in links are sent through Gmail (Google). Google processes your email address to deliver the message. A link works once and expires after 15 minutes.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We set one cookie that keeps you signed in. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

technical.title: Technical data
technical.body: Your IP address is held in memory for a few minutes to limit repeated requests. It is not written to the database.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: Account and fleet data are kept until the account is deleted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time. Write to {email}.
